args.goal: on the single-stage RFQ create screen, open Terms & Conditions, add the clauses "Payment within 45 days" and "Delivery within 7 days", leave both clause modes as None, leave "Mark all Terms & Conditions mandatory" unticked, click Done, and stop on the create screen
